rationale: Record the preferences the user stated this session as decisions (new baseline conduct: a stated preference goes into the journal when stated), so later sessions follow them without being told again.

ops.text: Commits carry no co-author or session trailers
ops.why: The user asked for commits without a Co-Authored-By line (2026-10-09). Commits keep the repo's own style (`scope: summary`, optional bullets) and a `Tend-Node:` trailer where a node applies; no Co-Authored-By and no Claude-Session trailer.

ops.text: kitty keeps its own colour scheme, not the desktop's Kanagawa
ops.why: When the Hyprland desktop was themed Kanagawa Dragon, the user chose to leave kitty on its own scheme ("bright lights" in kitty.d/kitty.conf). kitty.conf is shared with vgmacbook, and DESIGN.md themes terminal apps at the terminal emulator; don't retheme it as part of desktop theming.

ops.text: Proton Pass is the password manager
ops.why: The user uses Proton Pass personally (also the secret backend AGENTS.md names). It's installed on every NixOS desktop (nixtype.proton-pass) and as a cask plus Safari extension on vgmacbook; the system keyring (gnome-keyring on vgkraken) only holds apps' own session tokens and is not a password manager.
